submission.justification: Absorber-F1 at 4.5 mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.16% at 100 GeV. Through systematic optimization, simulations were performed at multiple thicknesses (3mm, 4mm, 4.5mm, 5mm, 6mm, 7mm) for F1, confirming that 4.5mm is optimal. This configuration outperforms F2 by 2.095 percentage points and F3 by 0.936 percentage points. The material satisfies the hands-on maintenance constraint, and the thickness is well within the required 2-10 mm range. F1's shorter radiation length (reference value) enables better shower sampling and superior energy resolution compared to F2 (1.6x longer) and F3 (1.2x longer).
